body:
Founder: "organize the kanban" -> "there is shit in there i dont know what
it is" -> "do the nasty" -> "whatever u think" (full delegated judgment).

Reviewed all 171 cards across backlog/priority/cruise. Removed 6, safely
and non-destructively:
- #7 (S202-200) -- a literal test artifact ("THIS IS A TEST DOES THIS WIND
  UP IN THE TEXT FILE OR IS IT A PHANTOM IN THE SYSTEM?").
- #320/#321 (BP-LVL-1236/1237) -- exact-text duplicates of #319
  (BP-LVL-1234), kept.
- #293 (BPLE-13331) -- exact-text duplicate of #292 (same ID, same text),
  kept.
- #52 ("208") -- superseded by #57 (S243-03), which explicitly says
  "(was '208')".
- #53 ("210") -- superseded by #56 (S243-04), which explicitly says
  "(was '210')".

Deliberately did NOT delete the many real, legible ideas sitting under
ugly ad-hoc numeric IDs (9999, 7799, 109777, etc.) -- those are real
backlog content, not junk, just badly-labeled; renaming them wasn't
attempted (no rename affordance in emily kanban, only move/add/rm).
Also deliberately did not re-triage priority-tier assignments -- that's a
judgment call about what to work on next, a separate decision from board
hygiene.

171 -> 165 cards. No code changed this pass.

⚓ ☃
title: Kanban board cleanup: removed test artifact + exact duplicates + superseded cards
